text:
ITEM 1 | Chopped salad mix in a loose heap on the left of the plate: pale yellow-green shredded leafy pieces (lettuce-like), diced pale green cucumber-like cubes, small orange-red diced pieces, and bright yellow kernels scattered throughout; moist, glossy with dressing sheen, pieces about 0.5–1 cm, covering roughly 20% of the plate | 110

ITEM 2 | Roasted small round green vegetables (Brussels sprout-like halves) in a cluster, dark green with charred brown spots and crisp-looking surfaces, each about 2–3 cm across, arranged in a diagonal line along the lower-left of the salad; about 8 pieces, roughly 8% of plate | 90

ITEM 3 | Mixed rice pilaf on the right side: light tan grains with visible chopped orange carrot bits, dark green herb flecks, and red-purple sliced onion pieces, loose and fluffy, spread over roughly 20% of the plate, about 1 cm thick | 180

ITEM 4 | Shredded cooked meat in the upper right: pale brown and tan fibrous strands with darker browned edges, moist, slightly glossy, pulled apart in irregular clumps about 3–5 cm, with some crisp-looking browned bits; covers about 10% of plate | 90

ITEM 5 | Pale cream-white chunks (cooked fish or poultry-like pieces) scattered on rice, soft and flaky with a moist surface, about 2–3 cm pieces, one large cluster near upper right and smaller bits in the lower middle; covers about 8% of plate | 80

ITEM 6 | Broccoli florets: bright green, slightly charred and darker at tips, dry-looking surface, florets about 2–3 cm across, one cluster at lower right and one small piece near the bottom center, together about 6% of plate | 60

ITEM 7 | Small dark brown roasted item (appears to be a whole cooked fruit or vegetable piece) with wrinkled, shiny dark surface, about 2 cm across, near the center-bottom beside the Brussels sprouts | 15

ITEM 8 | Small diced pale green pieces (cucumber-like cubes) with a moist, smooth surface, about 1 cm, two pieces at bottom center near the salad edge | 10
